title: Panorama camera
suits: pitches that are a journey or a place: travel, logistics, mobility, climate, a user's day, a timeline; one wide world the camera travels through, slide by slide, first light to dusk.

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: on the FIRST stop's section (or country({ field, brand, brand2 })): the whole palette derives from them; the sky keeps the field's light or dark side
params.Pack.pan.stop(id, { x, y, zoom }): each slide's view: x = left edge at depth 1 (0 … width − 1920), zoom ≥ 1 dollies in
params.Pack.pan.scene({ width, sky, skyTop, pla: a deck's own panorama: planes back to front, each { depth, draw, live, tick }
params.Pack.pan.country({ width, seed, turbines: the bundled scene: a road through layered country

details: the sky's colour journey follows the camera: first light, morning, golden hour, sunset, dusk along the road, so the deck's colours form one continuous journey
the sun arcs across the whole journey, rising out of a glow behind the hills and setting into one; during a glide it visibly moves, a little time-lapse
depth parallax: far ranges barely move, the road moves with the camera, the foreground grass sweeps past fastest
long moves pull the camera back slightly mid-glide, like a crane, then settle
the first arrival is a small establishing move: from the left, a touch higher and closer, settling onto the stop
terrain layers are translucent field-hued ink, so each layer picks up the sky behind it and far ridges fade into haze
a rim of warm light along the far ridge line
mist lies between the far ranges and the rolling hills
clouds drift on the one clock at their own speeds
wind turbines turn; one turns slower than the others
telegraph wires sag between poles, and a few birds sit on them
road dashes and white milestones with a red band give the glide its speed
chimney smoke grows, drifts with the wind and thins as it rises
one barn window lights late, after the first eight seconds
stars come out only at dusk, a few twinkle, and a meteor crosses high on the right once every 23 s
the headline ink is re-picked from each stop's own sky, so text stays readable from dawn to dusk on any brand
each slide holds its own view of the one panorama (shared images, a few DOM nodes), so print shows every stop
